monthly.start: first calendar day 00:00:00 local of anchor month
monthly.end: first calendar day 00:00:00 local of next month

interval_rule: period windows are half-open [start,end) and converted once to UTC for owner queries

trend_rule.direction: up when delta>0, flat when delta=0, down when delta<0, unknown when either value is unknown
trend_rule.percentage: display only when previous_count>0; otherwise null

projection_rules: explicit owner historical/excluded populations remain labelled rather than silently removed
timezone_separation: SLA/cohort membership remains LLD-06 America/Guayaquil authority
Objective scheduling/display timezone may be shown on Objective items but never shifts Overview period membership
